definitions.possession: Consecutive active ticks with the same player owning the ball; stopped play closes a spell.
definitions.firstTouchLoss: Spell <3 ticks, including kicks and losses; not necessarily a turnover.
definitions.interception: During continuous play, a pass changes last-touch team, including deflections; restart assignment excluded.
definitions.conversion: Goals / shot attempts; descriptive, not shot-level xG.
